messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Which is, in Italy, the national market surveillance authority competent for machinery, which the supervisory bodies must inform under Article 70(4) of Legislative Decree 81/2008?

response.text: Qual è, in Italia, l'autorità nazionale di vigilanza del mercato competente per le macchine, che gli organi di vigilanza devono informare ai sensi dell'articolo 70, comma 4, del Decreto Legislativo 81/2008?
